title: Build a Tiny Vision Transformer
blurb: Treat an image as a sequence of patches: patchify, embed with a class token and positions, attend, run a pre-norm block and measure how far each head looks.
intro: A vision transformer cuts an image into patches and runs a standard transformer encoder over them. The steps build patch extraction, the patch embedding with a class token and position embeddings, scaled dot-product attention over patches, a pre-norm transformer block, and the mean attention distance that shows whether a head looks locally or across the whole image. The capstone runs a complete one-block ViT forward pass and reports its logits and each head's attention distance.
